name: Beatnote
description: Two rulings a hair apart in pitch, so the beat between them draws a third pattern of its own.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 9%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 9%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 10.6%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 10.6%); opacity: 0.8; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
